product_family: AI-powered search engine with privacy-first architecture. Products: Andi Search Engine (consumer/web search), Trantora (proprietary search index), Search API (developer tool for AI agents).

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type 1
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence; security audits planned post-beta launch per privacy policy.

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type 2
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence; security audits planned post-beta launch per privacy policy.

certifications.name: ISO 27001
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence found on vendor domain or trust documentation.

certifications.name: GDPR Certification
certifications.proof_quote: Policy states 'Account features are not currently offered in EU/UK' and acknowledges 'compliance with applicable data protection laws' but provides no evidence of formal GDPR certification or audit.

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence; not applicable - product is a search engine with no health data handling scope.

certifications.name: PCI DSS
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence; payment processing not a primary product focus.

privacy.ai_training_note: Product is an AI search engine (uses LLMs internally) but does not train on customer search queries. Privacy-first architecture: the privacy policy states searches are 'completely private and not logged' and that Andi does not track users or save searches. No mention of using user search data to train models.
privacy.data_region: United States (US-based company; EU/UK account features not currently offered)

security.name: No Tracking
security.value: Yes - anonymous searches not tracked; no tracking cookies; no third-party analytics

security.name: Third-Party Data Sharing
security.value: Minimal - only where 'strictly necessary to provide the service'; no data brokers; no ad networks

products.name: Andi Search Engine
products.data_scope: Search queries (not retained for anonymous users); user profile data (for optional accounts; minimal)
products.notes: Available as web app at andisearch.com and Chrome extension. Anonymous users: no tracking, no data retention. Paid/account users: optional cloud storage with saved preferences. Version 0.8.0 (beta).

products.name: Trantora
products.data_scope: Public web data indexed; no user-generated content stored
products.notes: Proprietary search index that analyzes web content credibility and meaning. Not directly user-facing but powers the search engine.

products.name: Search API
products.data_scope: API requests and usage logs (for rate limiting/abuse prevention)
products.notes: Provides clean, structured data for AI agents and developers. No formal SLA or uptime guarantee mentioned.

compare.pricing_model: Freemium: free search engine with optional paid plans for enhanced storage/features; no ads
compare.data_residency: United States (company based in US; EU/UK features not yet available)

flags: Security audits are not yet completed - policy states they are 'planned post-beta launch.' Until audits are published, security claims are unverified assertions.
GDPR posture is vague and compliance not currently offered to EU/UK residents. No GDPR-specific DPA or standard contractual clauses mentioned. Company does not support EU accounts.
No Data Processing Agreement (DPA) publicly available. Users must email privacy@andiai.com to request DPA and details on international transfers.
Early-stage product (version 0.8.0 beta) - security and compliance practices may change. No formal SLA, uptime guarantee, or data retention guarantees stated.
No formal compliance certifications (SOC 2, ISO 27001) mentioned anywhere. Privacy-first approach is architectural rather than audit-based.

Identity verification: Legal entity is LazyWeb Inc. (dba Andi), based in San Francisco, YC W22 batch. Multiple domain variants exist (andisearch.com, andiai.com). Assessment is for andisearch.com / andiai.com (confirmed via privacy policy, About page, and Y Combinator listing). No entity named 'Andi Inc.' exists.
